text:
sam-dev: quick heads-up — opened PR for onprem auth sidecar + secrets consolidation. hoping for a quick security pass before tomorrow's merge window. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4821

maria-sec: looking now. first question — does this change KMS usage or just rekey how we store service tokens?

sam-dev: it changes storage surface (single vault path) and introduces envelope encryption calls to KMS on write. read path unchanged. diff snapshot:
```
- secret stored at /services/x/token
+ secret stored at /services/x/credentials/token_envelope:
    - envelope.kms_key: projects/…/locations/global/keyR
```

liam-platform: quick infra note — if the sidecar calls KMS from onprem, are we using the VPC NAT gateway? do we need specific egress allowlist for the KMS endpoint?

sam-dev: yes, calls go out via VPC NAT. I added the NAT route to the infra change but haven't added allowlist entries. thought we'd rely on region-level KMS endpoints, but happy to add IPs if you want.

maria-sec: need to avoid broad egress. please add an allowlist to the PR and a small note in the runbook about fallback behaviour if KMS unreachable. also add a Secret Scan job in CI — I flagged where the new path is so the scanner can skip false positives.

jess-privacy: tagging re: telemetry — does this sidecar log any token material or PII to stdout? need to ensure logs scrub tokens and that audit logs only contain envelope metadata.

sam-dev: no token material in logs, only envelope id + error codes. will add explicit scrub in logger and include a CI test for redaction.

anita-eng: FYI I can take infra signoff once sec confirms allowlist and runbook. planning to merge in the 2pm window tomorrow if we get a +1.

maria-sec: checklist from my side: 1) KMS key usage limited to envelope unwrap/wrap (no key rotation in this PR) 2) allowlist added for NAT egress to KMS endpoints 3) CI secret-scan job enabled and passing 4) runbook updated with fallback + rollback steps 5) logging sanitized and test added. once those are in, I'll give conditional approval.

sam-dev: will push commits addressing 1/3/5 now, adding allowlist + runbook next. ETA 30m.

deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled: 2025-06-03 14:00-14:30 UTC for refs/pull/4821

maria-sec: thanks — will re-check after commits. if everything's green i'll post LGTM. :thumbsup:

liam-platform: note to self — prepare NAT ip health check during canary.

sam-dev: thanks all — appreciate the quick turn. ping me if you spot anything in the follow-up commits.

maria-sec: saw the new commits. small nit: please move `kms_key` ref to infra secrets mapping instead of hard-coded project path in the service config. otherwise looks clean.

sam-dev: good call — updated. requesting final +1 from sec.

maria-sec: LGTM conditional met, leaving final approval after canary. :white_check_mark:

anita-eng: infra +1 from me, will watch canary and be ready to rollback if errors spike.

sam-dev: setting merge for 14:35 UTC if canary passes. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
